$comment: Which reftests the engine is known to draw differently from their reference, and why.
Keys are paths under conformance/reftests, with forward slashes; a key ending in /* covers that
directory. A value is 'pass', or 'fail: <what is missing>'. An entry is a claim with an expiry
date: when the engine starts drawing the pair the same, the test fails and says so.

tests.form/unclosed-dialog.html: fail: the reader's own sheet has dialog{display:block} but not dialog:not([open]){display:none}, so a dialog that was never opened is painted
